problem: The thesis title promises an evaluation of the system, and the reviewer named latency, resource use and reliability. None of these had been measured. The only installed-system success number was B8 (88/90 on 2026-10-04), which was never repeated.
change: P1 was registered before any run. A /proc + nvidia-smi sampler records resources every 0.5 s for a whole measurement window, and a phase file is joined to it by wall time. The decision pipeline was run per model with the live system stopped. The agent suite was run three times against the installed service. An exploratory diagnosis reads the goal records read-only and classifies every non-passing goal.
validation: Latency quantiles over 1,100 decisions per model come from the R1b/M2 raw files. Cold load, VRAM, GPU power and energy come from 200 decisions per model. Three suite runs gave 63/85 each, with 89/90 goals having the same outcome. The diagnosis gives the same cause counts in all three runs: 8 locked session, 9 planner context over budget, 6 invalid planner output, 2 unverifiable, 2 as in B8.
limitations: The desktop session was locked during the suite runs (ScreenSaver active), so eight goals measured the lock, not the agent. Disabling idle blanking does not unlock a session that is already locked: a window that touches the desktop must check the lock state first and refuse to start. Ollama's RSS (about 8.9 GB for every model) is the server's host memory, not the model size. One machine.
